newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan bolivar slips slightly against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan bolivar slips slightly against dollar.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed fractionally weaker at 477.25/478.25 per dollar Tuesday compared to 477/478 per dollar Monday, in quiet trade with foreign currency demand driven by expectations of falling interest rates, traders said.
Yields on the Central Bank's Monetary Stabilization, or TEM, bills were expected to fall at Wednesday's weekly auction, piling extra pressure on the bolivar, trader said.
The Central Bank was virtually the only foreign currency supplier on the market Tuesday, traders said, ensuring that the currency closed very little changed.
